GITANJALI
Phone: +91 8767081510  |  Email: gitanjali052004@gmail.com

LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/gitanjali-yadav-229771291  |  Prayagraj, UP, India 

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Detail-oriented Electrical  Engineering student  (B.Tech pursuing)  with  a strong foundation in  industrial  automation,  circuit

design,  and  power  distribution  systems.  Proficient  in  PLC & SCADA programming,  MATLAB,  and specialized  technical

analysis  for  engineering  workflows.  Demonstrated  practical  capabilities  through a  power  substation  internship  and core

hands-on automation and hardware projects. Seeking a challenging technical role to leverage engineering principles and

automation skills in an industrial environment. 

CORE SKILLS

Industrial Automation: PLC & SCADA Programming, Relay Logic Control (RLC), Automation Systems

Electrical Engineering: Power Distribution, Substation Operations, Circuit Design, Electrical Safety, Load Management

Technical Tools: MATLAB, MS Excel, MS Word, MS PowerPoint

Programming & IoT: Python, Internet of Things (IoT), Data Acquisition Systems

Soft Skills: Teamwork, Collaboration, Problem Solving, Technical Documentation

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE & TRAINING

Power Distribution Intern 08/07/2025 – 07/08/2025 | Prayagraj, UP

33/11 kV Power SubStation, Civil Lines

Monitored high-voltage power distribution networks and grid substation operations.

Assisted in daily load management tracking, equipment monitoring, and routine maintenance procedures.

Followed standard electrical safety practices, protective grounding protocols, and operational safety rules.

PLC & SCADA Trainee 10/07/2025 – 29/07/2025 | Industrial Training

Softronic Automation

Developed, simulated, and tested PLC ladder logic programs for industrial automation workflows.

Configured SCADA supervisory control interfaces for real-time process monitoring and data visualization.

Analyzed automation control logic configurations to improve system efficiency and process reliability.

ACADEMIC PROJECTS

Obstacle Avoiding & Line Follower Automated Systems Academic Development

Engineered autonomous micro-controller based mobile systems utilizing IR and ultrasonic sensing arrays.

Programmed motor driver control algorithms for directional guidance and real-time obstacle avoidance.

Laser Security & Wire Break Automation Alarm Systems Academic Development

Designed hardware circuitry for low-latency security infrastructures using operational amplifiers and sensors.

Mapped electrical schematics to chart proper sensory input pathways and alarm transistor thresholds.

EDUCATION

B.Tech in Electrical Engineering Pursuing

Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow

Diploma in Electrical Engineering Passed: 2023

Board of Technical Education Uttar Pradesh (BTEUP) | Score: 72.92%

High School (Class X) Passed: 2020

Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) | Score: 45.2%

CERTIFICATIONS & WORKSHOPS

PLC & SCADA Programming Certification – Softronic Automation

Relay Logic Control (RLC) Workshop – Core Electrical Automation Training

Internet of Things (IoT) Workshop – Connected Embedded Systems Frameworks
